summary.value: Action: (DEX + WLP) Check (+SL) vs an enemy's Magic Defense.

system.description: Action: (DEX + WLP) Check (+SL) vs an enemy's Magic Defense. Success: a soldier yields (SL) IP; an elite or champion yields a soul treasure worth up to (level × 30, ×50 for Villains). Once per creature. Takes the hoplosphere drop — one body, one clot.
